prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 15 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1247; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury is plausible for a crash like this one.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection with reported head trauma and subsequent concussion symptoms. Over the course of fifteen office visits, care consisted of symptom monitoring, cognitive and vestibular assessment, graduated activity guidance, and periodic re-examination. The mechanism of injury described is consistent with the reported concussion, and the clinical presentation is plausible for a crash of this type. Several examination findings, including balance and oculomotor measures, support the diagnosis, while other neurological screening tests returned within normal limits. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known to this provider. Treatment followed a typical course, with visit frequency decreasing as symptoms improved and the patient progressed toward return to usual activities. Billed services are consistent with the documented encounters, with no repeated or duplicate charges identified in the record.
